'''Garbelian''' was an individual who once visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Averam/Legends|Averam]]. [[Gender/Legends|His]] quote about war was recalled by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jarrow Rusher]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] and offered as encouragement to [[Beadle Lubboon]], a new recruit in the [[Rusher's Brigade]].
